applicability.collection_and_lease: Every sequence receives each of the first seven overlays at its applicable persistence or collection boundary.
applicability.process_death_post_commit: Only sequences whose authored truth includes at least one eligible factual publication. No publication boundary exists otherwise.

assertions.collector: Injected transport failure has the independently expected incomplete state and bounded attempt count; a separate PostgreSQL connection verifies the latest attempt and unchanged comparison head.
assertions.lease: Database-time expiry permits a replacement generation; an old worker is rejected and a separate connection verifies the replacement head.
assertions.preCommit: A separate child is killed after evidence insertion but before transaction commit. Independent SQL finds identical evidence, observation, run, event and publication counts with no uncommitted evidence. Recovery commits from a separate connection.
assertions.postCommit: A separate child is killed after publication COMMIT but before response. A separate connection recovers the exact receipt and independently counts one publication, receipt, idempotency record and publication event.

namespacePolicy: Each run and each case use a new test:matrix_ namespace. No existing namespace or live source is changed. Evidence is retained for independent inspection.
limitations: HTTP faults are deliberately injected. They do not claim an actual provider outage or production HTTP request.
PostgreSQL transactions and process deaths are real. They do not establish a public API or a successful Actions dispatch.
Authored test namespaces are retained as bounded evidence. No existing records are removed.
